input.quote: Upon the date of termination, all Customer payment obligations accrued hereunder through the date of termination will become due and payable. The termination of selected Service Option Attachments will not affect Customer's obligation to pay charges under other Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: § 3.5 Effect of Termination addresses only Customer's accrued payment obligations. Searches for transition, return, export, deletion and expiration turned up nothing: the only "return" obligations relate to Materials/Base Components on IBM's request (§ 8.1) and returning a signed copy of the Agreement (§ 14.20), and § 14.18 Data Protection is limited to contact-information processing. § 11.6 makes Customer responsible for Content but gives no exit rights. § 14.2 survives § 3.5 but there is no substantive obligation to survive. The Agreement therefore contains no post-termination transition assistance or Content/data return obligation, failing even the fallback (90 days' assistance and export within 30 days), so we insert the preferred exit provision (six months' assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable return within 30 days, then deletion with written certification) into § 3.5, which § 14.2 already preserves post-termination.

ops.text: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM shall: (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months following the effective date of expiration or termination, at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return to Customer all Content and other Customer data in IBM's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Content and Customer data from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit provision so IBM provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns our Content in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and only then deletes it and certifies deletion. The Agreement currently addresses only payment on termination, leaving no right to retrieve our data; we can accept a 90-day assistance period if that is easier to accommodate.
proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and Content return/deletion obligations in § 3.5 Effect of Termination.
